facts.fact: Oubangui Médias reports that in July 2026 the territorial administration ministry (MATDDL), supported by its technical operator CIVIPOL, was preparing to deploy a Central African application meant to cover, in time, the management of births, marriages and deaths; the software was not yet deployed.
facts.system: Système National Intégré de Gestion de l'État Civil (logiciel applicatif endogène centrafricain)

facts.fact: The article says the MATDDL, through its Direction Générale de la Décentralisation et de l'État Civil, is preparing the deployment of the civil registration application, with CIVIPOL as its technical operator.
facts.system: Système National Intégré de Gestion de l'État Civil (logiciel applicatif endogène centrafricain)

facts.fact: The article says the work follows the Politique Nationale de l'État Civil (PNEC), validated and adopted by the Head of State on 4 April 2025; it does not say the policy names the application.
facts.system: Système National Intégré de Gestion de l'État Civil (logiciel applicatif endogène centrafricain)

facts.fact: The article places the work within the project supporting the modernisation, securing and accessibility of the civil registration system, financed by the European Union Delegation; no domestic budget line is mentioned.
facts.system: Système National Intégré de Gestion de l'État Civil (logiciel applicatif endogène centrafricain)
